args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam model of a three-span cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete box-girder bridge (30+40+30 m, deck 12.5 m), per JTG D60-2015 / JTG 3362-2018.

Structure: idealization spine_beam_2d (MR-01); system continuous_on_piers (MR-05) since pier column geometry is given. Girder single-cell cast_box section integrated from geometry: A = 6.532 m², I = 3.564 m⁴; C50 concrete Ec = 34500 MPa (JTG3362-3.1.5); γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTGD60-4.2.1); w = 169.83 kN/m, m = 17.31 t/m (self-weight of main girder only, MR-07).

Bearings (laminated elastomeric, Ge = 1.2 MPa manufacturer value taken via MR-00): Abutments 0 and 3 - PTFE sliding, 2 per line, 400×500, 5×11 mm, S=10.10, Kv=3.614 MN/m, Kh=0. Pier 1 - PTFE sliding, 2 per line, 550×650, 6×11 mm, S=13.54, Kv=8.075 MN/m, Kh=0. Pier 2 - plain fixed, 2 per line, 600×700, 7×11 mm, S=14.69, Kv=8.974 MN/m, Kh=13.09 kN/m. Piers: twin Ø1.6 m C40 columns (A=4.021 m², I=0.643 m⁴, Ec=32500 MPa), heights 14 m and 8 m, base-fixed.

Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, 3 lanes; qk=10.5 kN/m, xi=0.78, Pk=320/340/320 kN for spans 1/2/3; impact factor μ=0.2023 from fundamental vertical frequency f1=3.4338 Hz (JTGD60-4.3.2).

generate_model succeeded (L1/L2/L3 checks pass). First three vertical frequencies: 3.434, 5.502, 6.354 Hz. Self-weight reactions ≈ 1839.7/6646.0/6665.6/1831.9 kN; self-weight mid-span moments ≈ 8490/12616/8372 kN·m; support moments ≈ -21233/-21469 kN·m. Max lane-load positive moment 9701 kN·m, max negative -7558 kN·m.
